skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Summarize acquired knowledge to identify theoretical and practical issues in land management
Apply acquired knowledge to analyze and evaluate theoretical and practical issues in land management
Link theoretical concepts with real-world land management and use issues
Identify appropriate land policies to explain specific land management situations
Explain and propose solutions for existing land management problems
Evaluate land management and use issues comprehensively
Be proactive in learning, research, and group work
Be proactive in choosing methods and research materials to analyze real-world land management situations
Be proactive in presenting research topics
